project_name: Indian E-Commerce Customer Retention Intelligence System Using Machine Learning
phase: Phase 5.1 — Advanced Model Optimization & Accuracy Improvement
checkpoint: Checkpoint 1.1 — Audit Corrections & Evaluation Protocol Verification
author: Senior Machine Learning Engineer and Independent Technical Auditor

objective.goal: Improve model generalization accuracy towards an aspirational 80% target through evidence-based feature engineering and algorithm benchmarking while maintaining minimum recall >= 70%.
objective.disclaimer: 80% accuracy is an aspirational upper bound. Ground-truth label generation contains an intrinsic theoretical Bayes error rate of ~26.03% due to stochastic Bernoulli trials on latent personas.

historical_development_cohort.role: Nested Stratified Cross-Validation (outer fold OOF probability collection, inner fold tuning, pipeline selection)

historical_phase5_test_set.role: FROZEN_BENCHMARK — Strictly prohibited from use in model selection, tuning, or threshold setting

proposed_independent_test_cohort.role: SEALED_OUT_OF_SAMPLE_COHORT — Evaluated exactly once at Phase 5.1 completion

outer_loop.purpose: Generate unbiased out-of-fold (OOF) predicted probabilities across all N=5,950 records for decision threshold selection without hyperparameter-selection bias.

inner_loop.purpose: Tune candidate hyperparameters and evaluate pipeline variations strictly on outer training folds (N=4,760).
inner_loop.leakage_boundary: No outer validation fold data ever informs inner tuning, scaling, encoding, or feature selection.

threshold_selection.source: Aggregated out-of-fold probability vector from the outer 5 folds
threshold_selection.objective: Maximize F1-score subject to mandatory constraint Recall >= 70.0%

feature_engineering_experiments.name: Velocity Momentum & Run-Rate Ratios
feature_engineering_experiments.description: Construct ratios of 30-day orders to 90-day run-rate and 90-day orders to 180-day run-rate with epsilon stabilization (+0.1) to prevent zero-division.

feature_engineering_experiments.name: Fulfillment Friction Interaction Index
feature_engineering_experiments.description: Synthesize delivery delay severity with customer return and cancellation rates. Missing delay values preserved as NaN rather than fabricated as 0.

feature_engineering_experiments.name: Logarithmic Transformation of Right-Skewed Variables
feature_engineering_experiments.description: Apply np.log1p inside Pipeline transformers to normalize right-skewed monetary amounts and recency days.

feature_engineering_experiments.name: Empirical Multicollinearity Pruning Evaluation
feature_engineering_experiments.description: Evaluate pruning candidate features with |r| > 0.85 inside training folds versus retaining all features across all algorithms.
candidate_pruning: Evaluate dropping hist_order_count in favor of hist_delivered_order_count
Evaluate dropping hist_total_order_value_inr in favor of hist_delivered_order_value_inr
Evaluate dropping recency_days in favor of recency_delivered_days
Evaluate dropping orders_last_180_days in favor of delivered_orders_last_180_days

candidate_algorithms.name: Stacking Classifier / Meta-Ensemble
candidate_algorithms.description: Blends out-of-fold probability predictions from top 3 diverse estimators using an L2-regularized Logistic Regression meta-learner.

evaluation_metrics.name: Recall (Class 1 Churn)
evaluation_metrics.rationale: Prevents catastrophic retention false negatives where high-value customers defect without intervention.

evaluation_metrics.name: Accuracy
evaluation_metrics.rationale: Improves overall model generalization and minimizes unnecessary retention coupon expenditures.

evaluation_metrics.name: ROC-AUC
evaluation_metrics.rationale: Measures threshold-independent ranking ability across entire customer risk spectrum.

evaluation_metrics.name: Precision (Class 1 Churn)
evaluation_metrics.rationale: Ensures retention offers are not squandered on low-risk customer accounts.

evaluation_metrics.name: F1-Score
evaluation_metrics.rationale: Guides decision threshold selection at the precision-recall trade-off point.

acceptance_criteria.zero_leakage: All feature engineering, scaling, and imputation transformers strictly wrapped inside Pipeline / ColumnTransformer objects fitted on training folds.
acceptance_criteria.recall_constraint: Final selected pipeline must strictly achieve test recall >= 70.0% on the independent test cohort.
acceptance_criteria.independent_test_isolation: Independent test cohort evaluated exactly once; no post-test tuning or threshold re-calibration allowed.
acceptance_criteria.preservation_of_phase5: Original models/phase5/ final pipeline and reports remain permanently intact as historical benchmark.

checkpoint_1_1_verification.churn_mechanism_verified: Verified that churn_decision is sampled from Bernoulli(churn_propensity) and future orders are generated conditionally such that churn == 1 iff zero future orders exist in the 90-day window.
checkpoint_1_1_verification.bayes_error_status: Theoretical population expectation under generator assumptions (~26.03% error); not an unconditional empirical ceiling on finite samples.
checkpoint_1_1_verification.threshold_comparison_corrected: Cross-dataset comparison removed; within-dataset validation (FP 175 at 0.50 vs FP 219 at 0.46) and test (FP 224 at 0.46) reported cleanly.
checkpoint_1_1_verification.nested_cv_established: Outer 5 folds for unbiased OOF probability assembly, Inner 3 folds for hyperparameter tuning.
checkpoint_1_1_verification.id_ranges_verified: Customers: 7,000 records (IND_CUST_10001 to 17000); Orders: 84,225 records (ORD_100001 to 184225, 72,240 historical + 11,985 future).
checkpoint_1_1_verification.collision_free_verification: Strict set disjointness check required before saving independent test cohort.
checkpoint_1_1_verification.semantic_missingness_preserved: Missing delivery delay not imputed as 0; missing discount not assumed 0; indicators retained.

milestone_roadmap.checkpoint_2: Independent Cohort Generation & Advanced Feature Engineering Setup
milestone_roadmap.checkpoint_3: Multi-Algorithm Pipeline Construction & Nested Stratified CV
milestone_roadmap.checkpoint_4: Hyperparameter Optimization & Decision Threshold Sweeping on OOF Probabilities
milestone_roadmap.checkpoint_5: Final Model Refit & Evaluation on Independent Test Cohort
